text:
## Escalation & Authorities  
| Fraud Amount | Investigation Level | Approval Authority | Timeline |
|---|---|---|---|
| **<£500** | Routine | CSR | 2–3 days |
| **£500–£5,000** | Standard | Manager | 3–5 days |
| **£5,000–£50,000** | Enhanced | Risk Manager | 5–7 days |
| **>£50,000** | Complex | Head of Crime + Legal | 7–14 days |
| **Serial/Pattern** | Specialized | Head of Crime + Police | 10+ days |

raw_entities.name: Fraud Investigation and Approval Process
raw_entities.description: An operational workflow for managing fraud investigations based on the monetary value of the fraud or the nature of the activity (serial/pattern). It defines investigation levels, required approval authorities, and expected resolution timelines.
context: Fraud Amount | Investigation Level | Approval Authority | Timeline

raw_entities.name: Level 1 — Routine Investigation (CSR)
raw_entities.description: The lowest tier of fraud escalation for amounts under £500. This level is handled as a Routine investigation with a 2–3 day timeline.

raw_entities.name: Level 2 — Standard Investigation (Manager)
raw_entities.description: The second tier of fraud escalation for amounts between £500 and £5,000. This is classified as a Standard investigation with a 3–5 day timeline.

raw_entities.name: Level 3 — Enhanced Investigation (Risk Manager)
raw_entities.description: The third tier of fraud escalation for amounts between £5,000 and £50,000. This is classified as an Enhanced investigation with a 5–7 day timeline.

raw_entities.name: Level 4 — Complex Investigation (Head of Crime + Legal)
raw_entities.description: A high-level escalation for fraud amounts exceeding £50,000. This is classified as a Complex investigation requiring joint approval from the Head of Crime and Legal, with a 7–14 day timeline.

raw_entities.name: Level 5 — Specialized Investigation (Head of Crime + Police)
raw_entities.description: The highest level of escalation triggered by serial or pattern-based fraud regardless of specific amount. This is a Specialized investigation requiring Head of Crime and Police involvement, with a timeline of 10+ days.

raw_entities.name: Customer Service Representative
raw_entities.description: The staff member responsible for the approval authority of Routine fraud investigations under £500.

raw_entities.name: Manager
raw_entities.description: The staff member providing approval authority for Standard fraud investigations between £500 and £5,000.

raw_entities.name: Risk Manager
raw_entities.description: The authority responsible for approving Enhanced fraud investigations between £5,000 and £50,000.

raw_entities.name: Head of Crime
raw_entities.description: A senior authority required for the approval of both Complex investigations (>£50,000) and Specialized investigations (Serial/Pattern).

raw_entities.name: Legal Department
raw_entities.description: The department providing joint approval authority with the Head of Crime for Complex fraud investigations over £50,000.

raw_entities.name: Police
raw_entities.description: External authority required for joint approval of Specialized investigations concerning serial or pattern fraud.

raw_entities.name: Fraud Amount and Pattern Assessment
raw_entities.description: A decision gate where the fraud amount and the nature of the fraud (single vs serial/pattern) are evaluated to determine the investigation level, approval authority, and timeline.
